title: Alliance Undercurrent
next_chapter_hook: Just as the traitor's identity was about to be exposed, a terrifying aura beyond Ling Yuan's imagination descended quietly—the Gaze of the Heavenly Eye had finally fallen upon Chen Ji.

text.content: Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, candlelight flickered, casting the faces of those within in alternating shadows. The moment Chen Ji stepped into the hall, he sensed an异样 atmosphere—the sect elders who should have been discussing defensive strategies now fixed him with gazes carrying an indescribable scrutiny. The word "废物" nearly overflowed from the whispered conversations.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji? How dare you show your face here?

text.content: Han Lie's voice exploded like thunder. He stood boldly in the hall, the Xuanwu Sect emblem fluttering behind him. The Xuanwu genius' eyes overflowed with disdain, his lips curved in a mocking arc, as if observing an ant that had wandered into a tiger's den. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged; he merely lowered his gaze slightly—he recorded Han Lie's arrogance, and every subtle change in expression from everyone present.

dialogue.content: Since the alliance was formed, what have you done besides hiding behind others and scheming? The brothers at the front are bleeding, yet you disappeared for days without a trace—who knows if you went to make some deal with the Demonic Path!

text.content: Before the words even finished, chaos erupted in the hall. Some wore looks of suspicion, others thoughtful frowns, and some had a barely concealed gleam of satisfaction in their eyes. Chen Ji冷笑—Han Lie's words seemed reckless, but every character was a fatal jab; if he couldn't handle this properly, today would mark the collapse of his authority. But this was exactly what he wanted—the storm, let it rage even fiercer.

Su Qingyao's clear voice cut through the clamor as she stepped forward, the bearing of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow suddenly blazing forth. Yet Han Lie showed not a trace of fear; instead, he smiled even more brazenly, that smile hiding a certain certainty, as if everything was under his control. Chen Ji noticed Su Qingyao's furrowed brow—she had sensed the abnormality too. Behind Han Lie, there was someone.

choice.prompt: Han Lie pressed forward step by step, the hall's atmosphere taut as a drawn bow; Chen Ji had to respond—

choices.description: Publicly expose Han Lie's hand, forcing him to eat his own words, reshaping authority with a crushing demeanor
choices.visible_reward: Deter all doubters in the hall
choices.risk_hint: May alert the forces behind the scenes

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his eyes, a faint, serene smile curling at the corner of his lips—a smile that sent an inexplicable chill through everyone present. He didn't hurry to defend himself; instead, he walked slowly toward Han Lie, each step seeming to tread upon the heartbeats of the crowd.
Han Lie, you want evidence? Very well, I shall give you evidence.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, feign weakness to lure the enemy
choices.description: Deliberately appear weak, making Han Lie even more arrogant, thereby exposing more flaws and drawing out the mastermind behind the scenes
choices.visible_reward: See through the faces of all enemies
choices.risk_hint: May damage reputation within the alliance

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice hoarse: "Han Shixiong's教训 is well-founded; I indeed should not have left without permission..." His tone carried just the right amount of tremor, his shoulders slightly hunched, the perfect picture of a man whose courage had been shattered.

Yet in that instant of lowering his head, his peripheral vision precisely caught several different gazes in the hall—one group exhaled in relief, another showed contempt, and others exchanged meaningful glances. Very well, all noted.

choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate Value, foresight key events about to occur within the next hour
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious; do not misuse it

text.content: Chen Ji silently recited the incantation; the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea grew slightly warm. Three breaths later, a blurry image emerged—behind Han Lie, a figure hidden in the shadows was silently making some signal, and that silhouette... was actually Ling Yuan!

The hall's atmosphere grew ever more delicate. Han Lie, seeing Chen Ji silent for so long, assumed he was intimidated by his imposing manner and was about to press further. He didn't know that Chen Ji's heart was already as clear as a mirror—he already knew what Han Lie was about to say, and when that "ally" would appear. The joy of setting a trap lies in seeing through the enemy's plans before they act.

dialogue.content: What? Nothing to say? A废物 is still a废物!

text.content: Han Lie's words grew increasingly jarring; someone in the hall began to agree, others watched coldly. Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even tighter; her hand had quietly gripped her sword hilt. Chen Ji noticed the worry in her eyes and felt a slight warmth in his heart—this woman, in the end, had chosen to stand on his side. But he slightly shook his head, stopping her with a glance. Now was not the time to act.

Just as Han Lie was triumphantly complacent, commotion erupted outside the hall. A scout stumbled in, covered in blood, his expression one of terror. "Report—! Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing leads her forces to attack; they are already thirty li outside the Sect Gate!" At these words, chaos erupted in the hall. Han Lie's expression changed slightly, yet he forced composure. Chen Ji, however, caught the fleeting strange glint in his eyes—not surprise, but some kind of... anticipation?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing attacking at this moment? The timing is a bit too coincidental.

text.content: Su Qingyao's words made everyone in the hall stare at each other. Indeed, the alliance had just shown signs of fracture, and the Demonic Path arrived as if summoned—this couldn't possibly be unrelated, even a three-year-old wouldn't believe it. Han Lie's expression finally cracked, though he quickly concealed it, but Chen Ji saw it clearly. Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, his voice calm as still water: "Han Shixiong, you just called me an insider traitor. Now that the Demonic Path is attacking, what do you think we should do?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji threw the question to Han Lie; under the gaze of everyone present, Han Lie had to take a stance—

choices.text: Force Han Lie to declare he would fight
choices.description: Before everyone, pin a "coward" label on Han Lie, putting him in an impossible situation
choices.visible_cost: Sever all ties with Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Strip Han Lie of his moral high ground

text.content: Han Lie's face instantly became a spectacular display of emotions. He had just been accusing Chen Ji; if he now advocated fighting, it would slap his own face; if he advocated retreat, it would mean abandoning the alliance. Chen Ji savored the struggle on his face, his heart as still as an ancient well—this move, he had employed many times before.
Han Lie clenched his teeth, yet had to挤出一句: "Fight! Of course we must fight!" Someone in the hall wore a mocking expression; Chen Ji recorded it all.

choices.text: Propose a secret meeting with Ye Qing
choices.description: Publicly declare willingness to go alone, exposing this as a trap set by Han Lie and Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Expose the truth, turn the tables
choices.risk_hint: If negotiations fail, there may be danger to life

text.content: Chen Ji said calmly: "Since the Demonic Path Saint herself has come, why not let me meet her?" At these words, chaos erupted in the hall. A flash of panic crossed Han Lie's eyes, though he quickly concealed it. Chen Ji saw it clearly—this was exactly the reaction he wanted.
Su Qingyao abruptly stood up: "You're mad!" But Chen Ji only smiled at her, that smile hiding a meaning only she could understand—rest assured, I know what I'm doing.

choices.text: Order a thorough investigation of the insider traitor
choices.description: Seize the chaos to expose the intelligence already in hand, forcibly drag out those colluding with Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: May allow the mastermind to escape

text.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold: "Before we fight, I'd like to ask—who leaked information to the Demonic Path?" At these words, Han Lie's face instantly went pale. Everyone in the hall also changed expressions, exchanging glances.

Chen Ji spoke word by word: "Han Shixiong, your earlier performance was a bit too deliberate." He turned to face the crowd, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority: "I have verified that there is indeed a traitor within the alliance."

Han Lie's face was ashen; just as he was about to retort, a strange laughter echoed from outside the hall. That laughter had terrifying穿透力, as if drilling directly into one's soul. Then, a black figure descended from the sky, landing in the hall. It was Ye Qing—the Demonic Path Saint's body now swirled with demonic energy, yet her cold eyes fixed solely on Chen Ji, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of her lips.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, I have come as promised. It's time for you to fulfill what you promised me.

text.content: At these words, chaos erupted in the hall again. Su Qingyao's expression instantly became extremely complicated; her gaze toward Chen Ji held both doubt and a certain anticipation. Han Lie, however, seemed to clutch at a lifeline, shouting sharply: "Excellent! There is indeed collusion! Chen Ji, what else do you have to say!" Yet Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, that smile hiding far too much—far more than Han Lie could comprehend.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, you came at the perfect time. I have a grand gift for you.

text.content: Chen Ji took a Jade Slip from his sleeve and casually tossed it toward Ye Qing. The Jade Slip traced an arc through the air and fell into Ye Qing's hand. She received the slip, her spiritual sense probing within; after a moment, her expression changed drastically, and those perpetually cold eyes displayed the first stormy waves of shock. She abruptly looked up, her gaze toward Chen Ji filled with disbelief.

dialogue.content: You... you knew all along? You were scheming against Ling Yuan from the very beginning?

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, not answering her question. Instead, he turned to Han Lie, his tone as casual as if discussing a trivial matter: "Han Shixiong, do you really think Ling Yuan will keep the promises he made you? He would sacrifice even his own disciple without hesitation, let alone an outsider like you?" Han Lie's face went deathly pale; he opened his mouth but couldn't utter a single word.

dialogue.content: So all of this... was your scheme?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice came from behind, carrying a tremor. Chen Ji turned around, meeting her eyes for the first time. In those eyes he saw too much—shock, understanding, and a faint, almost imperceptible... relief? As if she could finally set down her suspicions of him.

dialogue.content: Yes, and no. Ling Yuan wanted to use Han Lie; I merely went along with the flow.

text.content: Chen Ji paused, his gaze shifting from Su Qingyao to sweep across everyone in the hall, finally landing on Ye Qing. Ye Qing was staring at the Jade Slip in her hand, her eyes shimmering with complex light—that was the truth about her being used by the Holy Sect, the secret of her true origins. At this moment, she finally understood why Chen Ji had persuaded her to cooperate in that particular way. This man had calculated everything from the very beginning.

choice.prompt: The situation was settled, but Chen Ji knew Ling Yuan would never take this lying down—he needed to make a final decision—

choices.text: Press the attack on Ling Yuan's lair
choices.description: Unite Ye Qing's forces, take the initiative to strike at Ling Yuan's forces, solve everything in one blow
choices.visible_cost: The alliance's internal affairs are not yet stabilized; risks are extremely high
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a trap of "luring the tiger away from its mountain"

text.content: Ye Qing secured the Jade Slip, a狠厉 flash crossing her eyes: "Ling Yuan... what the Holy Sect owes me, I will collect today." She looked at Chen Ji, showing a genuine smile for the first time: "Chen Ji, you are more interesting than I imagined."

Chen Ji nodded, just about to speak, when a violent tremor suddenly came from outside the hall. That tremor carried a strange rhythm, as if some terrifying existence was tearing through space. Su Qingyao's face changed drastically: "This is... fluctuations in Heavenly Dao Laws?!"

choices.text: Watch and wait, stabilize the situation
choices.description: First handle internal alliance issues, wait for Ling Yuan to expose more weaknesses before acting
choices.visible_reward: See through the true faces of all enemies

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "No hurry. Since Ling Yuan set this trap, he certainly has follow-up moves. Now, acting rashly would only fall into his scheme." He turned to Su Qingyao: "Qingyao, could you do me a favor—investigate everyone Han Lie has been in contact with these past days?"
Su Qingyao nodded and left. Before departing, she glanced at him; that gaze held too many unspoken words. Chen Ji sighed in his heart—this woman, in the end, had chosen to trust him.

choices.text: Divide and conquer, dismantle Ling Yuan's forces
choices.description: Use the intelligence at hand to sow discord between Ling Yuan and other forces, making him a solitary figure
choices.risk_hint: May expose the source of one's intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing: "Do you still have usable people within the Holy Sect?" Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "What are you planning?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "I want Ling Yuan to know that the chess game he thought he controlled collapsed long ago."

Ye Qing pondered for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Good, Chen Ji, I knew I wasn't mistaken about you. That old fox Ling Yuan thinks he has every contingency covered, but he doesn't know that among the people he trusts most, three have already been turned by me."

Just then, Chen Ji suddenly felt a inexplicable chill rise along his spine. That was a warning from the Tianji Record Fragment—not from Ling Yuan, but from some higher, more terrifying existence. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shuddered violently, a blurry pattern slowly emerging, as if something was watching him.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That pattern... he had seen similar designs in the ancient texts occasionally revealed by Mo Xiansheng—it was the mark of the Heavenly Eye. Mo Xiansheng had once said that the Tianji Record was merely one of the pieces the Heavenly Dao had placed in this world. And now, the piece seemed to have noticed the existence of the one who plays the game.

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) It... has been watching me all along?

text.content: Chen Ji's face remained calm, but within his heart, waves crashed like a tsunami. From the very first day he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been scheming, calculating, step by step grasping fate in his own hands. But now he suddenly realized—perhaps from the moment he picked up the Tianji Record, he had already entered an even larger game. Ling Yuan was an enemy; the Heavenly Eye... what exactly is it?

Ye Qing seemed to sense his unusual state, frowning slightly: "Chen Ji? What's wrong?" Chen Ji snapped back to reality, shook his head, and forcibly suppressed that chill. This was not the time to pursue these matters—Ling Yuan's conspiracy had just been thwarted, but the Heavenly Eye's gaze made him realize that the true game, perhaps, had only just begun.
